challenge.ftdungeonmobs.tooltip: Both hands empty, sneak-right-click: start/join a challenge (tier locked at start)
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.help: FT challenges: sneak-right-click a torch with both hands empty, or /ftchallenge start|join|status|stop [x y z]. Right-click normally first to select tier 1-5.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.status: FT challenge | Tier %s | Wave %s/%s | Alive %s | Pending %s | Players %s | %ss left (tier locked)
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.started: Dungeon challenge started: tier %s, %s waves, attack in %ss. Teammates can sneak-right-click this torch with empty hands to join.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.joined: %s joined (%s/%s players). Enrollment closes when wave one begins.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.wave_started: Wave %s/%s incoming! %s enemies in this wave.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.eliminated: %s was eliminated and cannot rejoin or claim rewards this challenge.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reward: Tier %s victory loot and %s experience points received.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.cancelled: Cancelled %s challenge(s). No victory rewards; cooldown remains active.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reloaded: Challenge configuration reloaded. Active runs retain their parameter snapshot; disabling enabled stops them at the next check.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.peaceful: Challenges cannot start on Peaceful difficulty.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.player: Only living non-spectator players may participate.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.protected: You cannot use an arena torch here.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.torch: Use a loaded, complete two-block arena torch.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.range: You are outside this arena's radius.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.limit: The server has reached its active challenge limit.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.participat: You already participate in another active challenge.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.overlap: Challenge areas cannot overlap. Use another arena.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.cooldown: This torch or player is on cooldown: %ss.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.not_active: This torch has no active challenge.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.join_close: Wave one has started; enrollment is closed.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.not_owner: Only the initiator or an administrator may cancel this challenge.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.error.reload: Reload failed. Check ftdungeonmobs-challenges.toml; previous settings remain active.
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reason.absent: party left or disconnected for too long
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reason.spawn_blo: not enough safe, loaded spawn locations
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reason.torch_rem: torch removed, externally changed, or unloaded
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reason.enemy_los: an enemy was removed or unloaded, not killed
challenge.ftdungeonmobs.reason.out_of_bo: an enemy left the arena boundary
